name: Error_AI_Corrupt
source:
You are a computer scientist. You have gotten approved for funding on an Artifical Intelligence project in which you talk to a robot daily to see if it forms a attachment to the human. However one day you get a creeping feeling that your project is going to change. Whether that was for the better or the worst you decide. 

[From [url=https://astrainthegalaxy.itch.io/error-ai-corrupt]Itch.io[/url]]
